core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ramzi is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Of the sign”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ramzi corresponds to the Arabic form رَمْزِي (Arabic رَمْزِي (Ramzī) 'of the sign'). Its core sense is ramzi; symbolic, of the sign. Ramzi is Arabic رَمْزِي (Ramzī) 'symbolic, of the sign', a relational adjective from رَمْز (ramz). The source gloss 'Rare, Precious' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.

persian.name: رمزی
persian.long_meaning: Ramzi (رمزی) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن رمزی، نمادین است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
